test: Independent neutral Reading Notes forward test
independence: This separate agent received only the requirement and Skill/tool schema/examples, then fixed the original typed reference before writing component code or rendering. No past result or business submission inspected. The design is agent-authored; hash identity does not certify human approval or correct interpretation.
component: Real reusable ReadingNotes Swift package component and real Android main-source Composable, directly instantiated by thin caller bridges. Twelve long rows, initial/opened/replaced selected states; caller replacement preserves local open state.
schema_amendment: The root neutral probe identified AX/semantic bounds versus layout allocation ambiguity during this run. Preserved original pre-scope contract, plan, tooling snapshot and results. New lock only adds explicit layout_box measurement and approval metadata. Numeric source bytes, selectors, fixtures, action routes and component sources remain unchanged. Scoped replay uses the original raw native observation; no recollection claimed.
visual_result: All five overlapping initial native frames per platform inspected from heading through the fully visible footer. Readable complete sentences, hierarchy, separated markers/action/status and calm blue/pale surfaces pass visual intent. Also inspected immediate/post-action and replacement top/footer frames. Exact unsupported typography/layout allocation is not inferred from pixels.

original_attempt.defect: Selector-object extra expected field accepted by compile but did not override the sealed expected value. Full initial accepted output retained.

ui_loop: Initial viewport capture/review passes per platform. The profile stages an exact existing frame only after validating every current native source hash, original inputs, full image hashes, observation digest and executed test count/exit. Staging explicitly records reuse of this session's fresh native run; this is not a second native execution or a full-content numerical pass.
usability: Usable as an evidence-first native component workflow with pinned hosts. CLI outputs and typed-source provenance are inspectable, and updates/callback intervals are state-bound. Contract drafting/binding is substantial manual work. iOS main capture costs 118s for 12 rows because the observer performs multiple full sweeps as well as target navigation. No natural-language completeness or design-author correctness proof.
limits: Both collectors expose accessibility/semantic bounds; layout_box width and gap remain U on both platforms (6 cells each).
iOS public AX does not expose font_sp or color_argb for this SwiftUI text (6 additional U cells). Android actual text layout matches 16sp and #FF204B6D in all three selected states.
One 390-width light/LTR default-size scenario only; no dark, RTL, accessibility text size, narrow-width or localization claims.
iOS uses real simulator App/XCUITest. Android uses attached ComposeView/Paparazzi native semantics and OnClick, without Activity/device physical-touch claims.
Thin-host scrolling and caller replacement are covered; no business app navigation, keyboard, safe-area or lifecycle coverage claimed.
No independent raster golden; visual review is fallible agent judgment. Two N/A stimulus classes and target-only state visual limits remain in the matrix.
